slug: 2025-06-08 Teraco completes JB5 data center in Johannesburg, South Africa (DCD)

facts.fact: Data Center Dynamics reports Teraco completed JB5, its eighth South African data centre and third at the Isando campus (12 halls), bringing the campus to 70MW; the article gives no completion date, so its published date is used.

note: JB7 is due online in 2026: planned, not a fact.
